crop.notes: Only the first short item, 'The Prize Ring. - A Fight Arranged.', is about Allen. The rest of crop-1 and all of crop-2 and crop-3 are unrelated 'Illinois Items' and miscellany.

ocr.notes: The Allen item is mostly right ('tight' for fight, 'Alien' for Allen).

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen and Jas. C. Gallagher signed articles over Hennessey's saloon at Fourth and Morgan to fight for $1,500 on November 1 within 50 miles of St. Louis.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, September 20, 1870'.

facts.fact: Allen and Jas. C. Gallagher signed articles to fight for $1,500, Allen staking $1,000 to Gallagher's $500, on November 1 within 50 miles of St. Louis
places: room over Henessey's saloon, Fourth and Morgan streets, St. Louis

notes: This is the same event as article 420 (the Daily Missouri Democrat, same date).
